verdict.rationale: Orama is a programmatic search library with official JS/TS, Python and Rust SDKs, and it can be imported into runtimes such as Deno. That implies it can run without a UI in scripts. However, no evidence explicitly covers headless/CI usage, a CLI, or automation workflows. Missing for 10: an explicit headless/CI mode or guidance, a CLI for automation, CI pipeline examples, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: Orama Cloud officially supports the following SDKs: - JavaScript/TypeScript - Python - Rust
With Deno, you can just use the same CDN URL or use npm specifiers
